title: Using Hypothesis-Led Machine Learning and Hierarchical Cluster Analysis to Identify Disease Pathways Prior to Dementia: Longitudinal Cohort Study
summary: Hypothesis-led machine learning and hierarchical clustering identified diagnostic and symptom sequences preceding dementia in a matched longitudinal claims cohort, with held-out analysis. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
